name: volatile-leaves-v1
description: Leaf paths whose values legitimately differ between two runs of the same analyzer on the same input. Every entry must be a run id, timestamp, elapsed time or absolute path (or a hash of an artifact that embeds a run id). Anything else differing between A/A runs is a determinism bug. compare_dirs first rewrites any string or dict key starting with the snapshot directory's absolute path to start with the token <SNAP>, so chained outputs compare equal across snapshot directories. A policy entry ending in * (not [*]) matches every path with that prefix, e.g. inputs.source_hashes.<SNAP>* covers the hashes keyed by snapshot paths while hashes keyed by fixture paths stay compared.
